announcements.headline: Form 8 - Gresham House Energy Storage Fund plc
Launch of a Formal Sale Process
announcements.insight: Initiating a formal sale process for GRID signals a definitive exit from the operational energy storage asset class, likely driven by the need to crystallize value in a sector facing margin compression and high interest rates. This precedent mirrors the consolidation trend among smaller UK infrastructure funds seeking liquidity or strategic pivots away from heavy capex-intensive renewable generation.
